name: Commerce
description: Commerce — payment providers, catalog, cart, checkout (hybrid ship+deliver+register+subscribe), orders, customers, editable invoice templates + Content Editor emails with delayed review/follow-up triggers, media-library invoice logo picker, live cart tax/shipping quotes, free shipping from a cart amount, CMS entry stock sync after purchase, order cancel, Shopify cutover, promotions, gift cards, tax providers (manual + Stripe Tax), B2B VAT reverse charge, draft order editor, shipping rate providers (manual + EasyPost), live EasyPost fulfillment + tracking webhooks, ops intelligence (cohorts, fulfillment SLA, low-stock automation), import, and fulfillment. Replaces the legacy Payments plugin.
author: Birkly
